ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: advantage_weighted_logsigmoid_pairwise_tanh_relu_diff_mean_loss
ir.intuition: Repaired by introducing a stable, asymmetric smoothing of the normalized advantage margin difference using tanh followed by relu to focus only on positive margins, which better enforces pairwise ranking with margin. We replaced symmetric smoothing with an asymmetric activation to break similarity and improve learning signal, and retain weighted mean aggregation normalized by weight sum. This prevents loss symmetry and ensures margin emphasis towards correct ordering.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon = 1e-6
norm_adv = max(norm(advantage_gap), epsilon)
diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm_adv
scaled_diff = scale * tanh(diff)
asymmetric_diff = relu(scaled_diff)
loss = -logsigmoid(asymmetric_diff)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
loss_mean = sum(weighted_loss) / max(sum(weight), epsilon)
return loss_mean
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))
    epsilon = 1e-6
    norm_adv = ops.norm(advantage_gap)
    norm_value = ops.maximum(norm_adv, epsilon)
    diff = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_value)
    scaled_diff = ops.mul(scale, ops.tanh(diff))
    asymmetric_diff = ops.relu(scaled_diff)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(asymmetric_diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    weighted_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    loss_mean = ops.div(weighted_sum, ops.maximum(weight_sum, epsilon))
    return loss_mean
